metadata.methods_description: Each trial began with a space key press, followed by a fixation dot for 500-650 ms, then 2 or 6 lateral objects appeared for 1250 ms. A central cue indicated which object(s) to memorize while irrelevant objects appeared on the other side for visual balance. After a 1000 ms delay, half the blocks presented 4 distractors (dual task) requiring identification of a same-category object, while the other half showed only fixation (single task), with a colored dot providing feedback on dual task accuracy. Finally, a probe displayed 2 objects and participants selected the cued one using arrow keys, followed by feedback showing the correct object with colored cues.
